_note: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT substitution: Claude Code expands ONLY the plain ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} pattern. Do NOT use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-fallback} or any compound parameter expansion — the fallback is passed literally to bash, which then evaluates it with CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT unset, producing the wrong path. See commit cf85cfc in cdeust/automatised-pipeline (2026-04-25) for root-cause analysis. Use a bash -c wrapper so the shell handles ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} at invocation time.

args: PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python) && exec "$PY" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/launcher.py" mcp_server
